verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents an official MCP server (npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server, 96 tools) exposing domain registration, DNS editing, hosting provisioning and Cloudflare zone moves to Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client, corroborated by a dedicated /mcp page and probe confirming its existence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice, and no evidence of version/maturity beyond first-party docs.
